facets.label: General subject
facets.definition: A cross-domain matter that describes what the target is substantively about.

facets.label: Specialist subject
facets.definition: A domain-specific matter that depends on a specialist vocabulary.

facets.label: Legal location
facets.definition: A governed location or citation in a legal authority.

facets.label: Industry classification
facets.definition: Membership in a governed economic-activity classification.

facets.label: Affected population
facets.definition: A class materially regulated, protected, eligible, or burdened.

facets.label: Genre
facets.definition: The communicative form or source kind of the target.

facets.label: Regulatory action
facets.definition: An action proposed, performed, or decided by a regulatory actor.

facets.label: Administrative process stage
facets.definition: A governed phase or status in an administrative workflow.

facets.label: Code-list value
facets.definition: A member of a governed operational value set.

facets.label: Ontology class
facets.definition: Class membership in an identified ontology.

facets.label: Observation and measure
facets.definition: A measured, counted, estimated, modeled, or observed value.
